name: rotli
nameCasing: lowercase always — never "Rotli" or "ROTLI" in UI/copy
status: SHIPPED — canonical quokka identity and selectable exact-geometry full-body treatments, 2026-08-15.
source: The canonical quokka drawings in src/assets/characters/; historical identity explorations are non-shipping provenance only.

identity.what: A warm, local-first, hotkey-driven notes app for Mac — one menu-bar shell where your notes folder *is* a memex (one folder: notes · chats · knowledge · files). Two fronts: Chat (AI chats) · Notes (Capture · the AI-organized 'brain' wiki areas · Storage · Boards); an email Inbox front is on the roadmap. AI rides your own CLI subscriptions (claude/codex/agy) or a local MLX model — rotli bundles no LLM/STT/TTS and has no separate Voice front (dictation lives in a sibling app, voz).
identity.essence: Warm, quiet, instant — a visitor on your screen, not a resident.
identity.oneIdea: Cognitive quiet — it holds what matters and gets out of your way.
identity.metaphor: The quokka on Rottnest Island — small, focused, always smiling because the island was designed for it. The app is the island; every module is part of it; nothing has to be learned.
taglines: I will quietly hold what matters, and I will not get in your way.

values.line: Calm beats busy. Empty surfaces beat noise.
Lamplit, never clinical. Paper under a desk lamp.
Anticipates you. No loading states for what you're already doing.
Local-first. Rebindable. The user owns the app.

identity.nameRegister: Use lowercase "rotli" in product identity copy. The canonical line-drawn quokka is the compact visual identity.
voiceRules: Calm and unhurried — the app makes no demands; the copy doesn't either.
Plainspoken and warm — friendly, never salesy, never gamified (no streaks/achievements/upsell).
Personal-first — speaks to one person managing their own scattered digital life, not a team.
Quiet confidence — the product is the proof; don't lead with AI or hype features.

type: Personal-first productivity app · Mac menu-bar · local-first · warm/calm

color.tierDiscipline: Brand core = cocoa (ink) + clay (accent). Supporting = olive (success/secondary) + peach (tint) + linen (ground). Clay is punctuation, never a field; never body text; never two clay elements competing. No pure white in light mode; cocoa is the ink (no pure black UI).

font.displayNote: Bold (700) for headings; geometric-humanist, warm, rounded.
font.bodyNote: Regular (400) / Medium (500) for UI + body; legible at small sizes.
font.license: Fontshare (Indian Type Foundry) Free Font License — free for personal AND commercial use. Self-host. NOT OFL and NOT in the studio's standard Fontsource catalog (Mona Sans/Figtree/Inter) — a deliberate, the maintainer-approved deviation for rotli; recorded in LICENSES.md.
font.rejected: Cabin 600 — the prior rotli direction; retired.

mark.primary: The compact quokka drawing is the visual identity in titlebar, menu bar, app icon, site, and About placements.
mark.secondary: The product name may sit beside the quokka as ordinary lowercase text; it is not a separate vector wordmark.

meaning.warmth: The familiar quokka reads as friendly, calm, and personal without adding visual noise.
meaning.signature: The exact silhouette and linework stay consistent from compact mark to full-body companion.

mark.construction: The compact mark and eleven full-body poses are canonical source drawings. Cocoa and Fern fills are deterministic interior color treatments of those drawings, never redraws.

shape.note: Rounded + soft throughout — nothing sharp or clinical. The quokka's linework sets the tone.

candidates: soft paper-grain / dot texture at very low opacity
small quokka-world details used only in intentional personality moments
texture.note: Provisional — explore at the pattern step. Quiet, not busy; opacities below conscious perception. Construct programmatically.

icons.system: outline · consistent stroke · 24-grid · one idea each · hover label on every icon (quokka principle) · accent sparingly with clay (olive for success/sync)

motion.principle: calm + instant — the app visits, it doesn't sweep in
signatures: window show/hide = crossfade with a 1px lift (not a slide)

identityAssets.rule: The compact mark stays line art. The user's My quokka choice applies to full-body companions only.

supersedes.priorIdentity: The curled-r mark, outlined wordmark vector family, and generated r-mark tiles were retired and removed from the live kit on 2026-08-15. Historical provenance cannot be imported by shipping code.
